receipts.quote: OTEZLA/OTEZLA XR is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with oral ulcers associated with Behçet's Disease.
receipts.location: Section 1.3
limitations: Adult oral-ulcer indication; does not establish protection against ocular, vascular, intestinal or CNS disease.

receipts.quote: Infliximab neutralizes the biological activity of TNFα
